Parent work item: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-docs/-/work_items/1

This child work item is part of the BLT-docs redesign and platform documentation hub umbrella.

### Description

Define how BLT-docs should store, name, reference, and maintain screenshots and media for user/developer guide pages.

### Scope

- Define screenshot storage and naming convention under `docs/assets/`.
- Add guidance for screenshots in user guides and dashboard-like pages.
- Add alt-text requirements.
- Add update workflow for screenshots after UI changes.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Screenshot/media convention is documented.
- [ ] Asset paths are stable under `docs/assets/`.
- [ ] Alt-text and accessibility guidance is included.
- [ ] Docs explain when screenshots should be updated.
- [ ] Build passes with `uvx --with-requirements requirements.txt mkdocs build --strict`.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-docs/-/issues/10 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-04).

**Discussion summary**

- @Preetam-77 asked the review bot; it summarized the work as: store media under `docs/assets/`, stable paths and naming, alt-text rules, and when to refresh screenshots.
- GitLab MR blt-docs!4 stopped after 10 lines inside an unclosed code fence and is being closed; the review suggests adding this as a section of `developer-guide/writing-docs.md`.
